column1: # Cross-repo contract: check ID -> doc anchor in docs/findings.md of the ledger repo.
# Owner: system-tuning (the ledger is the home of judgement) at docs/contract.tsv.
# Pinned copy: genarch-settings at tests/contract.tsv. The engine's gate asserts the two are
# equal, equal to the compiled registry, and that every anchor resolves to a real `##`
# heading. Edit both copies in one change or the gate fails: a silently skipped check is the
# failure mode this seam exists to prevent.
